stage: Frozen used-source diagnostic before first additional value-pattern interpretation; not preregistration or clinical admission

numeric_policy.kind: Hypothesized nearest-last-printed-decimal compatibility interval around a finite scalar token
numeric_policy.target: Binary64 calculation of the source-declared LOQ/sqrt(2) replacement; registered value must match
numeric_policy.ties: Both interval boundaries included; not a verified source rounding policy

interpretation: Exclusive source-column pattern counts only. Compatible patterns are not verified censor flags, raw assay measurements, collection reasons, selection rules or clinical observations.
projection: Complete bounded CSV row strings are transiently decoded before projecting three numeric fields; other values receive no interpretation, output or persistence.
